fields.System.Title: TRF-401 — Report in-transit stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a network planner, I want to see everything currently on a lorry between sites, so
that stock that belongs to neither warehouse is still visible.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the report, then it lists every quantity in VIRT-INTRANSIT with product,
  • batch, origin, destination, dispatch date, and expected arrival.
  • - Given the report, then it can be filtered by origin, destination, and product.
  • - Given in-transit stock, then it is clearly labelled as unavailable at both sites.
  • - Given a partly received transfer, then only the outstanding quantity appears.
  • - Given the total, then in-transit plus on-hand across sites reconciles with the network
  • total.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, transfer_shipment |
| Risks | In-transit counted as available ([doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | integration · invariant |
